notes.subject: כ…כ…
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute, ol pasin i pairap — tupela tupela i wankain; Tok Pisin i ken tok 'wankain olsem' tasol i no gat namba bilong mak

notes.subject: כנשה כאשר נשא בו
notes.rationale: Ol man i save toktok: 'man i kastim pe wankain olsem man i pen pe' o 'wankain olsem man i hangamapim pe long en'

translation: Na bai i kamap olsem: ol man olgeta wankain olsem pris, save bilong wok wankain olsem masta bilong en, meri save bilong haus wankain olsem bikmeri bilong en, man i baim wankain olsem man i selim, man i givim mani long narapela wankain olsem man i kisim mani long narapela, man i holim pas long pe wankain olsem man i gat pe long en.
